scripts.test:auth: npm run test:auth:login && npm run test:auth:blank && npm run test:auth:wrong
scripts.test:products: npm run test:products:details && npm run test:sort
scripts.test:cart: npm run test:cart:add && npm run test:cart:remove && npm run test:cart:checkout
scripts.test:sort: npm run test:sort:az && npm run test:sort:za && npm run test:sort:price-low && npm run test:sort:price-high
scripts.test:menu: npm run test:menu:visibility && npm run test:menu:reset && npm run test:menu:about
scripts.test:all: npm run test:auth && npm run test:products && npm run test:cart && npm run test:sort && npm run test:menu
scripts.report:auth: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npm run test:auth && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:cart: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npm run test:cart && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:products: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npm run test:products && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:menu: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npm run test:menu && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:all: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npm run test:all && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
